entries.original: **feat(hud/cli): show persisted missions across the newest sessions by default and add `-s/--session` for an explicit session** (#4649, fixes #4648; @Jack11111eee, first contribution)

entries.original: **fix(runs-ledger): record start edges for session-scoped runs and report unattended runs ended without a notepad closeout** (#4646; @LukeTheoJohnson)

entries.original: **fix(release): run release-boundary checks when invoked through a Windows path** (#4645; @LukeTheoJohnson)
